author: BenjaminMichaelis
name: Benjamin Michaelis Aspire App
description: Creates a full-stack .NET Aspire solution with an ASP.NET Core Web API backend, optional Vue/React frontend, EF Core, ASP.NET Core Identity, and Azure deployment assets.

postActions.description: Restore NuGet packages required by this solution.

manualInstructions.text: Run 'dotnet restore' in the created project directory.

frontend.description: The frontend framework to include. Use 'none' for an API-only solution.

choices.description: Add a React + TypeScript + Vite + PWA frontend

applicationInsights.description: Add Azure Application Insights monitoring: Aspire auto-provisioning, the Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry exporter, and the Application Insights Profiler.

integrationTests.description: Add Aspire integration tests using TUnit. Tests validate that the AppHost starts successfully and services respond to requests.
